companyFieldUpdates.description: Valley Cold Storage & Transportation owns and operates temperature-controlled warehousing and logistics infrastructure serving food, agriculture and distribution customers in southern New Mexico, west Texas and northern Mexico. The business was established in 2008 and operates cold-storage facilities in Las Cruces and Santa Teresa. Ridgewood Infrastructure completed a founder-led recapitalization in Q4 2024. Clay Bush and Jennifer Bush continue to be identified by the company as owners; all current percentage stakes, the Ridgewood fund and the acquisition SPV are not publicly disclosed.
